marks.gloss_en: אי למעוטי היכא דיצתה נקבה לפניו -- מ״פטר רחם״ נפקא! (so 'בכור' must exclude the one after a caesarean)
Ravina: rather, conclude from it that 'firstborn' excludes one that emerged after a caesarean-born
אמר ליה רב אחא מדפתי לרבינא: ... אלא היכא דיצתה נקבה דרך דופן וזכר דרך רחם -- ליקדש, דהא איכא בכור לזכרים ובכור לרחם! (unanswered)
the stam: אלא מחוורתא כדאביי
Rav Acha of Difti: but where a female emerged by caesarean and a male through the womb -- let it be sanctified, for it is firstborn of the males and firstborn of the womb!
Rav Acha of Difti: granted where a male emerged by caesarean and a male through the womb -- not sanctified, excluded by 'firstborn': it is firstborn of the womb, not of the males
אילו בוולד בלבד הבהמה נפטרת כדבריך, אלא אמרו: סימן הוולד בבהמה דקה טינוף (unanswered)
the same rebuttal: a small animal is exempted also by tinuf (unanswered)
the same rebuttal: a large animal is exempted also by shilya (unanswered)
R' Akiva to him: were an animal exempted only by an offspring -- it would be as you say
R' Yishmael: [bought from a gentile, unknown whether it gave birth] a goat within its first year -- certainly the priest's
this is the principle: wherever it is known that it had given birth -- the priest has nothing here
'איש' כתוב בפרשה, ומקשינן אשה לאיש -- 'man' is written in the chalitza passage, and the woman is juxtaposed to the man: a female minor too does not perform chalitza
והא קטן וקטנה, דרובא דליתיה קמן, וקאזלי רבנן בתר רובא -- דתנן: ... ורבנן, זיל בתר רובא קטנים
R' Meir: a male minor and a female minor do not perform chalitza
מיכן ואילך אמאי ספק? הלך אחר רוב בהמות -- most give birth within their year, and this one certainly gave birth
follow the majority of animals: most animals conceive and give birth within their year -- so this one certainly gave birth
even [if he is like] the Rabbis: they follow the majority only for a majority before us, such as nine shops and the Sanhedrin; a majority not before us -- they do not follow
R' Meir: a male minor -- lest he be found a saris; a female minor -- lest she be found an aylonit; and they would be found to encounter a forbidden relation
and the Rabbis: follow the majority of male minors, and most are not sarisim; follow the female minors, and most are not aylonit
